dhUmasaMKyA -
dhUmastu #foot@- anyatra trividhaH proktaH | tathAhi carake - ‘prAyogikaH snehikaH doShavairecanika:’ iti | tatra prAyogike kAsaharaM, vairecanike vAmanIyamantarBAvyam | vAgBaTe~api snigdho madhyastIkShNaSceti | atrA~api snigdhe SamanavraNadhUpanabRuMhaNAnAmantarBAvaH | tIkShNe recanavAmayoriti virodhaparihAraH ||#ShaDvidhaH proktaH Samano bRuMhaNastathA |
recanaH kAsahA caiva vAmano GrANadhUpanaH || 1 || 
Samanasya tu paryAyau madhya: prAyogikastathA |
bRuMhaNasyApi paryAyau snehiko mRudureva ca || 2 || 
recanasyApi paryAyau SodhanastIkShNa eva ca |

vya_text: gU0 - tasya ShaDvidhatvamAha - SamanAdiBedena ShaDvidho dhUma: proktaH kathitaH | SamanabRuMhaNarecanaparyAyAnAha - Samano doShaSamanastasya paryAyau dvau ekaH madhyaH madhyanAmA aparaH prAyogikaH prAyogikanAmA | bRuMhaNasya dvau paryAyau ekaH snehanaH eko mRudu: | recanasyA~api dvau paryAyau ekaH SodhanaH aparastIkShNaH || 1 || 2 ||

dI0 - tatrA~ayaM sambandhaH - yathA nasyena cordhvajatruroganASastathA dhUmenA~api | uktaM ca vAgBaTe - ‘UrdhvajatruvikAreShu viSeShAnnasyamiShyate | jatrUrdhvaM kaPavAtotthavikArANAmajanmane || ucCedAya ca vAtAnAM pibeddhUmaM sadAtmavAn’ iti | tena nasyAdhyAyAnantaraM dhUmapAnAdhyAyaH || atha evaM karmapariSeShAt Suddhikaratvena nasyAnte dhUmapAnavidhirAraByate | tatra tAvatpUrvaM dhUmasaMKyAmAha - ShoDhA dhUmapAnaprakAraH | tatra Samana iti | duShTadoShasyAnirharaNapUrvakaM Samanam | aduShTasyAnudIraNaM ca | vyAdhiSamananena prastutavyAdhiSamanam | aprastutavyAdheranudIraNaM | taduktaM vAgBaTe – ‘na Sodhayati yaddoShAn SamAnnodIrayatyapi SamIkaroti ca kruddhAn tatsaMSamanamucyata’ iti | doShaSabdo~atra doSheShu doShakAryavyAdhiShvapi vartate kArye kAraNopacArAt | bRuMhaNa iti | bRuMhaNo balakaraH | dhAtuvRuddhikara ityanye | tadASrayatvAddoSho balaM recana iti | Siro virecayatIti recanaH | kAsaheti kAsanivAraNAya yo dIyate sa kAsahA kathitaH | vAmana iti | vAmayatIti vAmanaH | atha GrANadhUpana iti | nAsikayA pIto dhUmo GrANadhUpanasaMj~jaH | eke GrANadhUpanasthAne vraNadhUpana iti paThanti vyAKyAnayanti ca | etatsaMgatam | atha teShAM keShAMcitsaMj~jAntarANi darSayannAha - ekArthavAcakAH SabdAH parasparaM paryAyA ucyante | prayogaH svasthasya satatopayogaH | tatra sAdhuprAyogikAH snehA yatra BavantIti snehikaH || 1 || 2 ||

yeShAM dhUmo na vihitastAnAha -
adhUmArhASca Kalvete SrAnto BItaSca duHKitaH ||3|| 
dattabastirviriktaSca rAtrau jAgaritastathA |
pipAsitaSca dAhArtastAluSoShI tathodarI || 4 || 
Siro~aBitApI timirI CardyAdhmAnaprapIDitaH |

vya_text: gU0 - ekAnte SrAntAdayaH adhUmArhA dhUmayogyAH na | SrAntaH Sramayukta:, BIrurBayayukta:, duHKitaH duHKArtaH, kenacit duHKena pIDitaH dhananASAdiBiH | kShatoraska iti | yasya aByavahRutaM BakShitaM kShIraM kShaudram Asavo madyaM yena saH aByavahRutakShIrakShaudrAsavaH pumAn | tathA BuktAnnadadhimatsya: Buktam annaM dadhi matsyASca yena saH bAlaH vRuddhaH tathA kRuSo durbalaH || 3-6 ||

rAtrau jAgarita iti | rAtrijAgaraNena vAtavRuddhiH syAt | Siro~aBitApo SirorogapIDitaH | timirIti mandadRuShTiH | CardyAdhmAnaprapIDita iti | CardipIDitaH, AdhmAnapIDitaSca, AdhmAna udarApUraH | kShatoraska iti uraHkShatI | pramehArta iti pramehapIDitaH | rUkSho vAtaprakRutyA | athavA rUkShA~ahAreNa janitavAyunA pIDitaH | kShINa iti kShINadhAtuH | aByavahRutakShIrakShaudraGRutAsava iti | aByavahRutaM viSeSheNa BakShitaM kShIrAdikaM yena sa tathA | tatra kShaudraM madhu ete dhUmapAnaviShaye na yogyA ityaBiprAyaH | tatheti grahaNAt IdRuSA anye~api#foot@ tantrAntaroktA viShASIraktapittIpraBRutaya:|# boddhavyAH || 3-6 ||

pada:
akAle dhUmapAne doShaM tatpratIkAraM cAha -

tatreShTaM sarpiShaH pAnaM nAvanA~jjanatarpaNam || 7 ||

vya_text: gU0 - tathA akAle asamaye pIto dhUmaH upadravAn kuryAt | tatra dhUmopadrave kiM vihitaM, tatrAha - tatra dhUmopadrave sarpiShaH pAnam iShTam ucitaM nAvanaM nasyaM tathA~jjanatarpaNaM gaNDAdikaM sarpirGRutapAnam ikShurasaM pauNDrakAdInAM rasaM drAkShA gostanI payo dugdhaM gavyaM vA, SarkarAmbu vA sitodakaM vA, madhurAmlau rasau vA, SamanAya dApayet, sarpiShaH punaruktirviSeShaGRutaprayogArtham | drAkShAdimadhudravye gRuhIte~api punarmadhuragrahaNaM tasyaiva viSeShayogArtham || 7 || 8 ||

dI0 - atha yogyapItasya dhUmapAnasya doShamAha - akAla iti | asya kAlo virecanokto boddhavyaH | atipIta iti | vihitaparimANAdiByo~anyathA pItaH svamAnAdbahupIto vA | nAsAdeyastathA dhUmo yAvatA vartyavasAda ityAdi | upadravAnatra dhUmopahitajanitAn | te tu tRuShNAdAhajvarakShavathusadanAGrANarogAdhmAnAdayaH | tatpratIkAramAha - tatreti | dhUmapAnAtiSayajanitopadraveShu | iShTaM vihitaM grAhyamityarthaH | nAsAgatadoShadUrIkaraNAt | yato Greyamapyatra vettivetyupadravatvAt| a~jjanamapyatra tadvihitameva | yataH | rogopadravaH pItalohitatIkShNaistannirvarNatvAt | tarpaNaM santarpaNaM | tRuShNAdAhajvaropadravatvAt | yata: tRuShNAdAhajvarAdInAM sparSadoSheNa sIdatIti | kriyAsu asamartho BavatItyarthaH | ata eva tarpaNamiti | aparANyAha - sArpirikShurasamityeko yogaH | drAkShAM payo veti dvitIyaH | SarkarAmbu veti tRutIyaH | madhurAmlau rasau vApIti caturthaH | vamanAya pradApayediti vamanaprAbalyam | tantrAntaroktaM yathA ‘vamanAtkoShThaSuddhiH syAddhUmagandhaSca naSyati | vidhinA~anena SAmyanti sadanaM kShavathujvarAH’ ityAdi || 7 || 8 ||

vya_text: gU0 - dhUmo dvAdaSAdvarShAt gRuhyate aSItikAdvarShAnna gRuhyate tathA suyojito dhUmaH kAsAdIn hanyAt | dhUmopayogAt kIdRuSaH puruSho BavedityAha - dRuDhAH keSA dvijA dantAH SmaSruH muKakeSASca yasya saH || 9 || 10 ||

dI0 - atha dhUmasya vayoBedenopAdeyatvamanupAdeyatvamAha - dvAdaSavarShAdupari arthAdbAlyAvasthAyAH dhUmapAno yojyaH | yAvadaSItivarShANi Bavanti upari gRuhyate | aSItivarShAdupari dhUmapAno na vihita ityaBiprAyaH | etadviShayaM prAyogikadhUmapAne svasthopayogitvena darSitam | yato~anyatra sarvairnibandhakArairapaThitatvAt | atha samyag yojitasya dhUmapAnasya guNamAha - dhUmaprayogAt iti | samyak pItaH | atha dhUmayogena PalamAha | indriyANi buddhIndriyANi | teShAM prasannatA tadviShayagrahaNasAmarthyamityarthaH | vAkvacanaprAgalByaM manaH indriyatvenoBayAtmakatvAtpunargrahaNam | dRuDhakeSadvijaSmaSruriti | keSAH SiroruhAH SmaSru nAsAdhogatauShThoparilomaviSeShaH | dvijA dantAH | sugandhivadano Bavedityasya sthAne sugandhiviSadAnana iti kecitpaThanti vyAKyAnayanti ca || 9 || 10 ||

pada:
yayA nADyA dhUmo gRuhyate tadvidhAnamAha - 
dhUmanADI Bavettatra triKaNDA ca triparvikA || 11 || 
kaniShThikAparINAhA rAjamAShAgamAntarA |
dhUmanADI BaveddIrGA Samane rogiNo~a~ggulaiH || 12 || 
catvAriMSanmitaistadvaddvAtriMSadBirmRudau matA | 
tIkShNe caturviMSatiBiH kAsaGnI ShoDaSonmitaiH ||13|| 
daSA~ggulairvAmanIye tathA syAdvraNanADikA |
kalAyamaNDalasthUlA kulitthAgamarandhrakA || 14 ||

vya_text: gU0 - sAmAnyato yA dhUmanADI BavetsA triKaNDA trINi KaNDAni dorakAni yasyAH sA, triparvikA trINi parvANi granthIryasyAH sA triparvikA kaniShThikA~ggulI | tatparimANamAha - sthUlA punaH rAjamAShAgamA antare madhye rAjamAShaH tadgamaM Cidram antare Bavati | idAnIM SamanAdau dhUmanADIpramANamAha - Samane SamanadhUmapAne yA nADI nalikA sA rogiNAM catvAriMSada~ggulairdIrGA matA | mRudau mRududhUmapAne nADI sA dvAtriMSada~ggulairdIrGA | tIkShNe tIkShNadhUmapAne caturviMSaira~ggulairdIrGA | kAsaGne dhUmapAne yA nADikA sApi daSA~ggulaireva dIrGA IdRuSI | sthUlamAnamAha | kalAyo vartulakastat maNDalavatsthUlA punA randhre yathA kulatthAgamanaM Bavettadvat ||11-14 ||

dI0 - idAnIM dhUmapAnArthaM netrasvarUpamAha - tatreti | dhUmapAnaviShaye dhUmanADI dhUmapAnArthaM nADI netrABidhAnA | kathaMBUtA triKaNDA | ata eva triparvikA kathitA | trigranthiyutetyAdi | kaniShThikAparINAhetyanena gopucCAkArA kAryA | gopucCAkAratvaM ca triKaNDAnAmiti BAvaH | antare suShiraM tu rAjamAShavadvartulAnurUpaM kAryamityaryaH | eke antaranADikAyAH prAnte rAjamAShasadRuSaM randhraM vadanti | mUlamuKaM tu rAjamAShAt kiMcidadhikaM Bavati | kaniShThikApariNAhAkAratvAt | atha nADIsvarUpamaBidhAya saMprati SamanAdInAma~ggulaBedena nADIviBedamAha | daSA~ggulairvAmanIyaH etatpa~jcaprakAraM muKyapAnatvena nADIviShayatvAdvihitam | ShoDhA saMj~jakamavaSiShTaM yat GrANadhUpanam | tasya nADIsvarUpaM vakShyamANaM boddhavyam | ata eva nADIBedenaiva pa~jcaprakAraM pUrvamuktaM tadyathA - dhUmanADI | Samaneti SamanAKyadhUmapAnayogyetyarthaH | kathaMBUtA | Aturasya catvAriMSada~ggulairdIrGA | nanu tantrAntare aShTacatvAriMSada~ggulaiH parimitA nADI prAyogikABidhAne SamanadhUmapAne praSastA tathAca ‘elAdinA kuShThanatoddhRutena kShaumaM vilipyA~ggulakAShThamAnam | prAyogike vartiriyaM tu netramaShThA~ggulaM ShaDguNitaM praSastam’ iti suSrutenoktam | apare tu ShaTtriMSada~ggulaM prAyogike netramAhuH | taduktaM ‘sArddhaM tryaMSayutaH pUrNo hastaH prAyogikAdiShu’ iti | tatkathamatra catvAriMSada~ggulaiH parimitaM netram ? ucyate | samalasya tu madhyaH | prAyogikasya tu dvau Bedau darSitau | tadBedatvena nADIBedamapi jAnIyAnna doShaH | athavA SleShmaprakRutau baddhadoShe ca nare ShaDviMSada~ggulA mAtrA | anyatra tvaShTacatvAriMSada~ggulaM tena virodhaH | svamate tvAcAryeNa viSeShaM vicArya sAmapratipAlanArthaM madhyaBAvaM netraparimANaM liKitamityadoShaH | evaM vakShyamANaparimANeShu kutracidvirodheShu boddhavyam | mRudAviti bRuMhaNAKye dhUmapAne dvAtriMSada~ggulamitaM netraM Bavati | tIkShNa iti recanAKye dhUmapAne caturviMSatya~ggulamitaM netramatra | kAsaGne dhUmapAne ShoDaSA~ggulipramitaM | nADIviShaye vAmanIye dhUmapAne daSA~ggulaM netramiti | pUrvamuktaM vraNadhUpanArthaM nADIsvarUpamanyatrAha dhUmanimittam | IdRuSI nADikA netrAKyA Bavati | kAdRuSI | kalAyamaNDalasthUleti | nADikA uttaramuKaM vraNalagnArtham | kalAyasadRuSaM maNDalaM kAryaM kalAyo vartulakalAyaH | punaH kathaMBUtA | kulatthAgamarandhraketi | kulattho~annaviSeShaH prasiddhaH | tadgamanaSIlo randhraH suShirastena saMyuta ityarthaH | nADikArandhraM tu kulatthasadRuSaM kAryamiti BAvaH || 11-14 ||

idAnIM dhUmapAnArthaM IShikAvidhAnamAha - 
atheShikAM pralimpecca suSlakShNAM dvAdaSA~ggulAm | 
dhUmadravyasya kalkena lepaScAShTA~ggulaH smRutaH || 15|| 
 kalkaM karShamitaM liptvA CAyASuShkaM ca kArayet | 
IShikAmapanIyAtha snehAktAM vartimAdarAt ||16||
a~ggArairdIpitAM kRutvA dhRutvA netrasya randhrake | 
vadanena pibeddhUmaM vadanenaiva saMtyajet || 17 ||
nAsikAByAM tataH pItvA muKenaiva vametsudhIH | 
SarAvasaMpuTe kShiptvA kalkama~ggAradIpitam || 18 || 
Cidre netraM niveSyAtha vraNaM tenaiva dhUpayet |

vya_text: gU0 - IShikA SaratRuNaviSeShajanyA yA daSA~ggulAnAM dhUmadravyakalkena limpet punaH SuShke vartisnehoktaM kRutvA IShikAm apanIya dUrIkRutya netrasya nalikArandhre dhRutvA dIpitAM kRutvA vadanena dhUmaM pibet | vadanenaiva tyajet | tataH nAsikAByAm evaM kRutvA vadanenaiva vamet | vraNadhUmastu dIpanakalkaSarAve dhRutvA Cidre netraM niveSya vraNaM dhUmayet ayaM dhUmapAnavidhiH ||15-18||

dI0 - idAnIM vartividhAnaM darSayitumAha - atha IShikAM pralimpediti |#foot@ cakradatte tu - 'oShadhairvartikAM kRutvA SaragarBAntaSocitAm' iti SaragrahaNaM, carake~api -'piShTvA limpecCareShIkAM vartiM yavajasanniBAm' iti dRuSyate | tasmAdIShikANAmalABe JarakANDena pibet ||# korthaH piShTairBeShajaiH karpaTAvayavaM praliKya tena SarakANDama~ggulIsamamaShTA~ggulamAnena veShTayitvA tataH pariSoShya vartiH kAryA | avaSiShTaM catura~ggulaM SarakANDagrahaNArthamuktam | snehakAdiShvapi vartikaraNam | IShikA kASamucyate | ‘ShAguri’ iti loke | atha kathaM vartiH prajvAlya netre dhAryA tatprakAramAha | adalAditi | dalamatra patralepaM | IShikAvartividhAnaM ca prAyogike pradhAnatamaM | ropaNIyA vartiriyam | ShaDBAgagodhUmena netramAvartyAtmAnaM praSasyata iti | kecit snehenAByajyedagninA dagdhvA netre niveSya dhUmaH peyaH | yadA vadanena muKena kRutvA dhUmaM pibet tadA muKenaiva tannirgamaM kuryAt | nasikAByAM pItamapi muKenaivameva vamedityarthaH | nAsikAByAmiti dvivacanena nAsikArandhradvayena sambandhaH | tata ityanena muKapItenetarameva nAsikayA pItamityarthaH | tathAhi ‘muKena taM vametpUrvaM nAsikAyAM punaH pibet’ iti | nanu tantrAntare nAsikApItaM paScAnmuKapItaM dhUmaM doShakaraM Bavati tathAca - ‘muKapItaM muKenaiva nastaH pItaM ca nastataH | yo vamennastato dhUmaM nastapItaM muKena vA | sa netrakarNanAsAsyasaMSrayAt laBate gadAn’ iti | tatkathamatra nasikAByAM tataH pItvA muKenaiva vamet sudhIriti grahaNam | ucyate | sudhIrityudIraNenA~atra virodhaparihAraH kRutaH | yato dhUmapAnaBedena rogaviSeShe~api kutracinmuKapItaM kutrApi nAsikApItaM vA | muKanAsikApItamiti | tathAcoktaM -‘uraHkaNThASraye roge muKenaiva pibennaraH | SiraHkaNThAkShinAsauShThe nAsayA satataM pibet | tiryaktve tu muKenaiva nAsayA na kathaMcana | pragADhaM pAnamicCanti dhUmasyAMSena tadvida’ iti | kathaM pibedityapi darSanAt yathA tatra prAyogikaM trIMsnInucCvAsAnAdadyAt | prANena prINayet trIMScaturoveti | ‘snehikaM muKanAsAByAM yAvadaSru pravartanam’ | nAsikAByAM vairecanikamAdoShadarSanAt | muKenaiva kAsaharaM SvAsaSuddhirlAGavaM Sirasi samaH evaM vicArya muKapItaM muKenaiva vamet | nAsApItaM ca nAsikayaiva | uBAByAM pItaM muKenaiva vamedityadoShaH | ata eva sudhIpadanirUpaNamatra virodhaparihArAya boddhavyam | idAnIM dhUmapAnaviShayatvena GrANadhUpanamapyAha - kalkamatra nimbavacAdInAM vihitam | yataH ‘vraNe nimbavacAdInAM dhUpanaM saMpraSasyata’ iti | Cidre iti SarAvasaMpuTarandhre | netramiti nADIviSeShaH | sA dhUmapAnArthe kathitaiva tadvadatrApi j~jeyam | vraNadhUpanaM tu vedanAsrAvaSAntaye iti | athavA pUrvamuktaM SamanAdidhUmaBedaM vihitam | athavA - ‘SarAvasaMpuTayutaM vraNadhUmaM nayedvraNe | dhUmanetreNa matimAn vedanAsrAvaSAntaye’ iti || 15-18 ||

pada:
SamanadhUmAdau yaddravyakalko dhUmArthaM deyastadAha -
elAdikalkaM Samane snigdhaM sarjarasaM mRudau || 19 || 
recane tIkShNakalkaM ca kAsaGnaM kShudrikoShaNam |
vAmane snAyucarmAdyaM dadyAddhUmasya pAnakam || 20 || 
vraNe nimbavacAdyaM ca dhUpanaM saMpraSasyate |

vya_text: gU0 - Samane elAdikalkaM deyam | elAdirelAdigaNaH tatrailAdinA kuShThavarjeneti suSrutaH | tathA elAdigaNo vAgBaTe - ‘elAyugmarukkuShThaPalinImAMsIjaladhyAmakaM, spRukkAcorakacocapatrasugurusthauleyajAtIrasAH | SaktivyAGrinaKomarahvamagaruH SrIvAsakaH ku~gkumaM, caNDAgugguludevadhUparavapunnAganAgAhvayAH | elAdiko vAtakaPau viShaM ca viniyacCati | varNaprasAdanaH kaNDUpiDakAkoShThanASanaH’ | eShA vartiH prAyogike prAyogikaM tu tri:triSvAsenAdadIta viSeShatastu prAyogikaM GrANenAdadIta mRudau snigdhaM sarjarasaM snehaPalAsAradhUmocCiShTasarjarasaguggulupraBRutiBiH srehamiSraiH sneheneti suSrutaH | kAsaGne kShudrikoShaNaM kShudrA kaNTakArI vyoShaNaM maricaM bRuhatI kaNTakArikA trikaTukAsamardaka i~ggudItvagmanaHSilA CinnaruhA karkaTaSRu~ggIpraBRutiBiH kAsaharaiSca kAsaGnairvAmanaiH snAyucarmAdyaM dadyAt | snAyucarmaKuraM SRu~ggakakarAsthiSuShkamatsyavallUrakamiSrapraBRutiBirvAmanIyaiH iti suSrutaH | snAyunADI suSrute ‘dhUmaH pa~jcavidho BavatI’tyuktaM tadyathA prAyogikaH snehano virecanaH kAsaGno vAmanIyaSceti SamanadhUmastu Binnaprayoktastena SAr~ggadhareNa ShaDvidho liKitaH || 19 || 20 ||

dI0 - atha pUrvamuktaM SamanAdidhUmaBedaM ShaTprakAraM tadarthaM katipayAni dravyANyAha - Samane prAyogike elAdikalkaM dhUmapAnArthamAhuH | elAdigaNamatra suSrutoktaM tadyathA -‘elAtagarakuShThamAMsIjaladhAmakAM tvakpatranAgapuShpapriya~gguhareNukAvyAGrInaKaSukticaNDAGauNeyaka-SrIveShTakacorakabAlakaguggulusarjaturuShkapuNDarIkAgaruspRukkoSIraBadradAruku~gkumAni purANakesaraM ce’ti | tatra prAyogikanimittatvena kuShTha: tayoH parityAgaH kAryaH mastiShkasrAvaBayAt | yaduktaM ‘natakuShThe snAvayato dhUmavartiprayojite | mastulu~ggapraBAvena tasmAttaM na prayojayet’ iti | mRudAviti bRuMhaNAKye | snigdhamityeraNDAdiPalamajjAprAyam | athavA snigdhamityanena samastadhUmavidhAnaM sasnehaM kAryamiti pUrvoktatvAt | sArjarasamiti | sarjarasaprAyaM prAyogikamityarthaH | taduktaM -‘snigdhaBajjamadhUcCiShTasnehaguggulusarjakaiH | snehikA bastireBistu netraM dvAtriMSada~ggulam’ iti | recanatIkShNakalkamiti | recanamiti SodhanAKyadhUmapAne | tIkShNakalkamiti SirovirecanadravyakRutavartirityartha: | SirovirecanairvartirnetraM hastamitamityuktatvAt | SirovirecanairityapAmArgabIjAdiBiH | hastamitamiti caturviSada~ggulaM | kAsaGre kShudrikoShaNamiti kAsaGne dhUmapAne | kShudrikA kaNTakArikA | UShaNamatra trikaTukaM grAhyaM tantrAntaradarSanAt | tadyathA bRuhattryUShaNaM bRuhatI SRu~ggI ce~ggudItvagmanaHSilA | eShA kAsaharA vartirnetraM ShoDaSakAMgulam’ iti | vAmane snAyucarmAdyamiti | vAmane dhUmapAne | snAyucarmAdyaM vartyai dadyAdityarthaH | AdigrahaNAt asthiKuravallUramapi gRuhyate | taduktaM ‘vAmanIye tu ballUrasnAyvasthiKuravarmaBiH| vartirdaSA~ggule netraM dhUmaH pa~jcavidho mata’ iti | vallUraM SuShkamAMsamiti | eke dhUmasya pAnakamityanena GrANadhUpanasya vyAKyAnaM kurvanti tatra dhUmasya GrANadhUpanasya pAnakamiti tadvihitadravyamityarthaH | iti na sarvamataM | ‘dhUmaH pa~jcavidho mata’ ityAdivacanAt || 19 || 20 ||

pada:
bAlagrahAdau dhUmapAnamAha -
aparAjito dhUpaH
anye~api dhUmA geheShu kartavyA rogaSAntaye ||21|| 
mayUrapicCaM nimbasya patrANi bRuhatIPalam |
maricaM hi~ggu mAMsI ca bIjaM kArpAsasaMBavam ||22|| 
CAgaromAhinirmokaM viShThA vaiDAlikI tathA |
gajadantaSca taccUrNaM kiMciddhRutavimiSritam ||23|| 
geheShu dhUpanaM dattaM sarvAnbAlagrahA~jjayet |
piSAcAnrAkShasA~jjitvA sarvajvaraharaM Bavet || 24 ||

vya_text: dI0 - athAnye gRuhadhUmAH santi tAnapi prasa~ggato darSayannAha - ayamaparAjitasaMj~jo dhUpaH prasiddha eva | tatra bRuhatIPalaM kaNTakArikAPalaM | mAMsI jaTAKyA | ahinirmokaM sarpaka~jculikaM | viShThA baiDAlikI mArjArapurISham | nanu tantrAntare mAheSvaradhUpasaMj~jo~ayaM kathamatrAparAjitasaMj~jaH | ucyate - tatra mAheSvarasaMj~jatvena rudranirmAlyABidhAnatvAdadoShaH | taduktaM - ‘rudrajaTAgoSRu~ggaviDAlaviShThoragasya nirmokaH | madanaPalaBUtakeSIvaMSatvag iti nirmAlyam | yavamasUracandrakacCAgalaromANi sarShapAH savacAH | hi~ggugajadvijamaricAH samaBAgA CAgamUtrasaMpiShTAH | dhUpanavidhinA Samayantyete sarvajvarAnniyatam | grahaDAkinIpiSAcapretavikArApaho dhUpa’ iti bahudravyoktakalpanAdvA na doShaH || 21-24 ||

pada:
dhUmapAne pathyaM, netradravyANyAha -
parihArastu dhUmeShu kAryo recananasyavat |
netrANi dhAtujAnyAhurnalavaMSAdijAnyapi || 25 || 
iti SrIdAmodarasUnunA SAr~ggadhareNa viracitAyAM
SAr~ggadharasaMhitAyAmuttaraKaNDe dhUmapAnavidhirnAma
navamo~adhyAyaH || 9 ||

vya_text:
dI0 - atha dhUmapAnapariharaM netrArthaM dravyaM ca darSayannAha - dhUmeShviti | ShaDvidhadhUmapAnaviShayeShu parihArastyAjyABidhaH | sa ca virecananasyavat kAryaH | tattathaiva j~jAtavyam | athavA parihArastu dhUmeShu kAryo recanavattatheti pAThAntaram | yathA virecanokte sati pravAtasevAmbusnehAsaMgamajIrNatAmityAdikaM seveta tathA dhUmapAnake sati tatra vAtasevAdiparityAga ityaBiprAyaH | netrANIti | dhUmapAnArthaM nADIyantrANi tAnyanuktatvAddaSadhAtujAni nalavaMSAdijAnyapi boddhavyAni | dhAtavo~atra suvarNAdyAH | AdigrahaNAdanyakAShThadantaSRu~ggaGaTitAnItyarthaH || 25 ||
